newsitem.title: UK: UK Health Department to prioritise PFI projects.
newsitem.headline: UK Health Department to prioritise PFI projects.

text.p: Britain's Labour government said on Tuesday it would review all major Private Finance Initiative (PFI) schemes in the acute sector of the National Health Service.

Alan Milburn, health minister in charge of resources, said in a written parliamentary answer the "prioritisation exercise" would grade projects according to health service needs, how likely they were to succeeed and how far negotiations had progressed.
"Only if resources are concentrated on those schemes with the greatest need will real progress be made and schemes delivered," Milburn said in the answer.
"Final announcements regarding the fate of all the schemes will be made at the end of June," he added.
Milburn said the department would only invite competition for schemes with a genuine health need and which could be delivered. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
